description: Least-privilege capability set for the PulseTrader main window (ADR-0020). Core app/event/window/webview permissions only. NO filesystem, shell or HTTP capability is granted, and scripts/check-capabilities.sh asserts that absence at both the capability and the dependency level rather than trusting review. Note that the app's own #[tauri::command] functions need no permission entry -- Tauri v2 permissions gate CORE and PLUGIN commands, so this list stays short as screens are added.
